decision: Do not install: choreography gate failed. Preserve as blue-card tracking experiment.
inspected: Decoded contact sheets at every source frame through empty return, full-frame overview through frame 96, native browser playback and diagnostic fixed-size overlay.
improvements: Only one card; visibly extracted from shoe mouth.
Back white centre dot changes to coloured front-corner pattern through an observed thin edge.
Empty-hand return and stationary card after release.
Landed card closely matches approved Box 4 target. Fixed physical-size table fit needs no scale changes.
failures: The same hand extracts, turns and places the card; requested hand-to-hand transfer is absent.
Prolonged grip at shoe and upright presentation gesture. Release about 2.29s rather than requested roughly 0.9s.
Unrequested white Box 4 label added to table.
Blue detection absent at thin-edge frame 28; corner colour candidates include border ringing and cyan bleaching. No claim of reliable full-clip marker correspondence.

tracking.scope: Diagnostic face-up frames 31–96 only. No replacement card rendered in game.
